facts.text: I am trying to get my daily routine more organized.
I want a schedule template that I can customize to fit my needs.
I plan to wake up at 7:30 am on weekdays.
I plan to do yoga on Mondays, Wednesdays, and Fridays.
I usually head out the door by 8:15 am.
I usually take a lunch break from 12:30 pm to 1:30 pm.
During my lunch break, I usually watch TV shows.
During my lunch break, I usually catch up on my favorite series.
I usually practice a new language during my daily commute to and from work.

keyphrases: daily commute to and from work
